title: Arga is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents | TechCrunch
summary: Arga builds training environments for enterprise software like Salesforce, Workday, and email clients. Those tools make it much easier to set up RL environments for coding, which lets us test and train AI systems on increasingly complex coding tasks.
